item.title: Nekogami-sama to, Nanatsuboshi -Imouto no Ane-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sweet & Tea
  • 発売日: 2019-02-22
  • スコア: 6.67/10 (305 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ネコ神さまと、ななつぼし -妹の姉-
  • 英語名: Nekogami-sama to, Nanatsuboshi -Imouto no Ane-

别名

  • ネコつぼ

あらすじ

One day, while Reiji and his sister Erika are out for a walk, Reiji slips on the stone steps of a small shrine, cracks his head, and ends up at death’s door. Fortunately for him, a cat-eared girl named Fuuko appears to save his life. She says she’s a god and that, in order to save him, she put three of the seven fragments of her divine powers into him, and now they’re trapped inside.

item.title: Karenai Sekai to Owaru Hana
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sweet & Tea
  • 発売日: 2016-11-25
  • スコア: 7.58/10 (634 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 枯れない世界と終わる花
  • 英語名: Karenai Sekai to Owaru Hana

别名

  • 永不枯萎的世界与终之花

あらすじ

Shou and Ren arrived at a beautiful town full of colourful flowers. They met the three sisters Haru, Kotose and Yukina, who run the cafe “Famille”, and he starts working there in exchange for a bed to sleep in.

In the middle of the night, Shou follows Haru far away from the town to a hill covered with flowers as far as the eye could see. He watched as a little girl whom Haru was embracing turned into a flower under the large moonlit tree. She noticed his presence and smiled lonesomely while looking fondly at the beautiful flowers in full bloom.
